Starlette 1.0.1 fixes CVE-2026-48710 but is incompatible with apache-airflow-core 3.2.1 which requires starlette>=0.45.0,<1. Waiting for either a 0.x backport fix or an Airflow update to support starlette 1.x.

Fix requires Starlette 1.0.1, a major upgrade from the current 0.50.0 dependency. The image definition explicitly constrains starlette to <1.0.0 to avoid breaking changes in the major version upgrade. Compatibility assessment for Starlette 1.x is pending.
